name: PayrollRTI 0.2.0-beta.1
body:
## What's changed

- Settings as three tabs instead of one long list (b1e9a25)
- Find Basic PAYE Tools wherever the installer put it, and let the user choose (f5d1bc2)
- Split the DOS date expressions; Xcode 26.3's type-checker gave up on them (32cdf0c)
- Pass swiftlint --strict and swift format (cdb9f99)
- PayrollRTI updates itself from GitHub releases; pre-release tags publish pre-releases (5cec5d5)
- Engine choice screen to the agreed design, with Rosetta detection (b2f57a6)
- Check updates against HMRC's own feed and back up before any change (5c92ed5)
- Explain the engine choice and check each against the payroll database (a047df0)
- Add a selectable engine: HMRC's Mac installer or their Linux build run natively (9f332a9)
- rehost: default the runtime to a space-free path; CPython's Makefile needs one (aa5c130)
- rehost: record the live NVR submission result (cf0fad9)
- Spike: run HMRC's Linux BPT bytecode on a native arm64 CPython 2.7 (9cc7173)
- Skip the main-branch DMG build when only docs, tests or tooling change (3de99de)
- Remove marketing and design material; use a light not-installed screenshot (b47e2ef)

Runs HMRC's free [Basic PAYE Tools](https://www.gov.uk/basic-paye-tools): either their Mac installer in /Applications, or their Linux build, which PayrollRTI downloads and runs natively on Apple silicon.

**Pre-release for testing.** Your payroll data is backed up before anything changes it, but please keep your own backup too and report problems in the issues.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/seatofthepants-net/payrollrti/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0-beta.1
